verdict.rationale: Shopify publishes a live Global Catalog MCP index that lets agents search purchasable products across many merchants. Each UCP storefront also publishes a well-known profile describing its services, capabilities and payment handlers, so agents can discover what a merchant offers and how to pay. However, this is a product catalog plus per-origin profiles, not a published directory of payable services and APIs in general. Missing for 10: a cross-provider registry or index of payable services/APIs (beyond product listings), a way to enumerate UCP-enabled merchants or endpoints, and independent corroboration of discovery at directory level.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can discover payable services and APIs through a published directory or discovery index

citations.quote: The Global Catalog MCP server enables AI agents to search and discover products across the entire Shopify ecosystem, helping buyers find products from multiple merchants.
